scope: Existing frozen runner/manifests and completed stage receipts only; no profiling, process query, proof, compiler, SDK API, project helper or runtime data rehash.
production_final_result: not assessed; original parent handle remains authoritative

reconstructed_state_at_post_export_immut.method: Union of paths bound by fixed source control flow, declared existing manifest rows, and stat sizes of the small fresh production file set; no access to parent process memory.

timing_from_existing_receipts.qualification: The process-end to next-stage gaps include run() post-wait hashing, binding, terminal receipt fsync and adjacent code as well as immutable(); no per-file or per-loop timer isolates those costs.

static_findings: Between completed exports and Comparator startup the runner calls immutable(), constructs the command/environment and calls run(); it does not parse NDJSON or run another compiler in that gap.
immutable() first rehashes every bound path, then resolves every recorded path. Each SHA pass opens every file, checks remaining() per 1 MiB and at file completion, and uses SHA256.

Python 3.12 Path.resolve(strict=False) calls ntpath.realpath and then stat. Normal existing unprefixed Windows paths in this implementation usually call _getfinalpathname twice; fallback/error branches may differ. For 171235 paths, the normal branch therefore represents about 513705 metadata API calls, not a measured runtime count.

The closure records 43549 original cached-data files and 43549 clean overlay copies, each totaling 6090328304 bytes. Both path sets are bound and rehashed; their combined 12180656608 bytes are about 77 percent of runtime-closure declared bytes.

Only 17 closure paths use WSL UNC, totaling 6427980 bytes. Neither small count/size nor earlier successful checks prove their current latency. No file or UNC path can be identified as the bottleneck from these receipts.

The resolutions loop has no per-iteration remaining() call; subsequent run()/write operations do check the deadline. finish() calls the same full immutable() again after both replay stages. No final duration or outcome is inferred from the earlier gap.
not_established: Time separately spent in SHA reads, file open/close, filesystem resolution, antivirus, memory/page-cache pressure, or WSL UNC.
